typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	LoadDatatotblMSRBtradesReportedVolume_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CUSIP as string,
		{Trade Type} as string,
		XREF as string,
		{Settlement Date} as string,
		{Submission Date} as string,
		{Trade Date Time} as string,
		{Par (Face Amount)} as string,
		{Buy Sell} as string,
		{Trade Status} as string,
		{Clearing ID} as string,
		{Effecting Broker} as string,
		Capacity as string,
		{Dollar Price} as string,
		{Regulatory Dollar Price} as string,
		Yield as string,
		Commission as string,
		{Accrued Interest} as string,
		{Final Money} as string,
		Concession as string,
		{Weighted Average Price} as string,
		{Special Condition Indicator} as string,
		{Contra Clearing ID} as string,
		{Contra Effecting Broker} as string,
		{Contra Capacity} as string,
		{Trade Reporting Indicator} as string,
		{Settlement Type Indicator} as string,
		{Extended Settlement} as string,
		{Issue Type} as string,
		{Previous XREF} as string,
		TID as string,
		{Match TID} as string,
		{Reg ID} as string,
		{Message Sender ID} as string,
		{Reversal Indicator} as string,
		{Reversal Control Number} as string,
		MEOR as string,
		{Market of Execution} as string,
		{Export Date Time} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FileName = toString(($sFileName)),
		LoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		Par_Drv = replace({Par (Face Amount)}, toString(','), toString('')),
		RegDollarPrice_Drv = replace({Regulatory Dollar Price}, toString(','), toString('')),
		{Accrued Interest_Drv} = replace({Accrued Interest}, toString(','), toString('')),
		FinalMoney_Drv = replace({Final Money}, toString(','), toString('')),
		DollarPrice_Drv = replace({Dollar Price}, toString(','), toString(''))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileName} = FileName,
		{Copy of Par_Drv} = toDouble(Par_Drv),
		{Copy of DollarPrice_Drv} = toDouble(DollarPrice_Drv),
		{Copy of RegDollarPrice_Drv} = toDouble(RegDollarPrice_Drv),
		{Copy of FinalMoney_Drv} = toDouble(FinalMoney_Drv)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		dollarPrice as double,
		weightedAvePrice as string,
		cusip as string,
		concession as string,
		contraCapacity as string,
		TradeReportInd as string,
		meor as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		tid as string,
		reversalInd as string,
		capacity as string,
		messageSenderId as string,
		marketOfExecution as string,
		yield as string,
		contraClearingId as string,
		commission as string,
		previousXref as string,
		tradeType as string,
		buySell as string,
		parValue as double,
		xref as string,
		finalMoney as double,
		specialConditionInd as string,
		contraEffectingBroker as string,
		regulatoryDollarPrice as double,
		accruedInterest as double,
		submissionDate as string,
		settlementDate as string,
		tradeDate as string,
		effectingBroker as string,
		clearingId as string,
		SettlementTypeInd as string,
		issueType as string,
		ReversalControlNum as string,
		exportDate as string,
		filename as string,
		extendedSettlement as string,
		tradeStatus as string,
		matchTid as string,
		regId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		dollarPrice = {Copy of DollarPrice_Drv},
		weightedAvePrice = {Weighted Average Price},
		cusip = CUSIP,
		concession = Concession,
		contraCapacity = {Contra Capacity},
		TradeReportInd = {Trade Reporting Indicator},
		meor = MEOR,
		loadDate = LoadDate,
		tid = TID,
		reversalInd = {Reversal Indicator},
		capacity = Capacity,
		messageSenderId = {Message Sender ID},
		marketOfExecution = {Market of Execution},
		yield = Yield,
		contraClearingId = {Contra Clearing ID},
		commission = Commission,
		previousXref = {Previous XREF},
		tradeType = {Trade Type},
		buySell = {Buy Sell},
		parValue = {Copy of Par_Drv},
		xref = XREF,
		finalMoney = {Copy of FinalMoney_Drv},
		specialConditionInd = {Special Condition Indicator},
		contraEffectingBroker = {Contra Effecting Broker},
		regulatoryDollarPrice = {Copy of RegDollarPrice_Drv},
		accruedInterest = {Copy of Accrued Interest_Drv},
		submissionDate = {Submission Date},
		settlementDate = {Settlement Date},
		tradeDate = {Trade Date Time},
		effectingBroker = {Effecting Broker},
		clearingId = {Clearing ID},
		SettlementTypeInd = {Settlement Type Indicator},
		issueType = {Issue Type},
		ReversalControlNum = {Reversal Control Number},
		exportDate = {Export Date Time},
		filename = {Copy of FileName},
		extendedSettlement = {Extended Settlement},
		tradeStatus = {Trade Status},
		matchTid = {Match TID},
		regId = {Reg ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($LoadDatatotblMSRBtradesReportedVolume_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> LoadDatatotblMSRBtradesReportedVolume
